observation_summary: The StrBuilder.contains(char) method incorrectly checks beyond the active buffer size, leading to assertion failures when searching for characters in a modified StrBuilder.
reasoning_summary: The bug report explicitly states that StrBuilder methods are using the buffer length (thisBuf.length) instead of the active size (size). This is a boundary condition error where the code fails to validate the search range against the actual active data length. Such boundary validation errors are classified as Checking.
evidence_used: The contains(char) method is looking beyond the end of the string
StrBuilder contains usages of thisBuf.length when they should use size

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the loop logic is involved, the root cause is specifically the incorrect boundary condition (using buffer length instead of active size), which is a classic Checking defect.
